What is in this folder, and where each file came from.

Nothing here is edited. Each file is its publisher's own, fetched once and
committed, so the site never asks another server for it (spec section 7.1:
everything a page needs is served from this site). To update one, replace
the file and its lines here in the same commit.

Fetched 2026-10-11. Each file's bytes were compared with the sha512 value
cdnjs publishes for it (api.cdnjs.com, field "sri") and matched.
